bootstrap.method: Whole games with replacement within old/new holdout strata; fixed stratum sizes; identical draws across all eight models; ratios of summed counts.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile; pointwise, not simultaneous across actions or random seeds.

limitations: All eight fixed endpoints retained; no best-seed or checkpoint selection.
Mechanism success requires both seeds separately and is not full quality success, qualification, deployment or the user target.
Full-quality status passes only if all six fixed comparisons pass the unchanged original gates and support rules.
Strict architecture preservation triggers when control is above .75; original full-quality preservation also protects control equal to .75.
Only pooled source-stratified discard lower CI is a mechanism gate; old/new source intervals are descriptive.
FP counts use the same actual/offered windows for every model; zero-to-zero passes the FP guard, but missing accuracy/support never passes.
FitMonitor is a selected diagnostic subset, not full fit support or an independent holdout.
Internal holdout does not certify formal validation/test performance or four-player actions.
